supersedes.reason: The original slice review found that the Core performance gate trusted a self-described executable, allowed measurement-only output to appear qualifying, retained stale PASS reports after failure, and did not preserve reproducible baseline provenance. This record binds the complete-package authentication, immutable snapshot, failure invalidation, raw samples, exact hardware, measurement-tool identity, and reviewed package identity added by the remediation.

outcome: The Windows x64 desktop owns a self-contained, exact-inventory Python/FastAPI Core sidecar, starts it without a terminal or system Python, verifies a strict versioned process-bound handshake and real readiness, supervises one contained process tree through cancellation/crash/retry/shutdown, and qualifies only the exact independently approved package and immutable performance baseline.

integrationChecks.result: At exact clean state 1866a18, the gate verified the exact approved 644-file/31569506-byte package, report SHA-256 ebcb88b4..., manifest SHA-256 8908b324..., and entrypoint SHA-256 226746b8... before execution. Its locked private snapshot passed all seven measured lifecycles: readiness p50 831.352 ms, shutdown p95 219.501 ms, and idle working-set p95 62418944 bytes, within both absolute and 20-percent boundaries. Baseline SHA-256: 1ff9a0936d1b015b48e519896da9120c3ec0b5ce2b0d2d3c7e62b5a9ac185425. Report SHA-256: 3f9debc0d408a435d59a974fc19bae248fc99f40680f7004090668eeb2a69914.

Seven focused tests pass. They reject altered raw samples/aggregates, non-finite values, hardware/tool/package provenance drift, substituted entrypoint/inventory/report/manifest identities before execution, a persistent mid-lifecycle replacement, incomplete handshakes, relative regressions, and stale PASS survival after measurement-only or failed runs.

All 71 governed Python files remain formatted, lint-clean, and type-safe. Focused Ruff check/format and MyPy also pass for the changed benchmark and test. Quality report SHA-256: b6b880fbb1d81de60bff83f65a29dc7479bdd19e1b9294cdc87855640c2b2af5.

The original exact clean slice state dde0288 passed desktop (25 commands/149 foundation/42 desktop), service (19 commands/149 foundation/9 service/2 contract/6 packaging with a fresh build), and e2e-local (16 commands/149 foundation) once at slice review. Their report SHA-256 values remain 291bbf67..., 4b8f726f..., and b5ca660c.... The remediation changes exactly five benchmark/baseline/test/documentation files and no runtime, artifact, dependency, application, native supervisor, UI, contract, build input, or profile definition, so AGENTS.md risk-based selection defers replay of unchanged 7-11 minute profiles and reruns the complete hardened qualification gate instead.
All three tasks remain DONE with exact evidence chains and independent approvals. Planning views and architecture remain governed; these checks are rerun after attaching this superseding evidence.

integratedBehavior: Core provides strict local-only health, readiness, version, configuration, module, OpenAPI, and runtime contracts; actual served responses validate their schema variants and malformed or hybrid states fail closed.

The self-contained Python 3.14.6/PyInstaller 6.21.0 onedir artifact has an exact 644-file identity and dependency inventory, runs without system Python on PATH, rejects mutation or missing dependencies, and writes reports through confined guarded output.

Tauri lifecycle commands dispatch blocking work off the main thread. Windows creates Core suspended, assigns KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE containment, then resumes it, closing the descendant escape window before application code executes.

Only one lifecycle operation may own or publish the sidecar. Stop, startup cancellation, delayed readiness publication, retry, crash observation, graceful shutdown, forced shutdown, and host-drop cleanup retain ownership until the complete contained process tree is dead.

The renderer receives exactly state, bounded attempt, retry availability, and an allowlisted opaque diagnostic. It receives no endpoint, nonce, PID, path, environment, raw output, credential, or research content; malformed adapter values fail closed.
Production and development expose one functional CAP-01 application page. The 32-page HTML reference and its illustrative/nonfunctional content remain confined to design and conformance tooling.

Performance qualification authenticates the complete approved package before execution, locks and revalidates a private snapshot around every lifecycle, and compares exact hardware and package identity against an immutable baseline retaining raw samples and measurement-tool provenance.

downstreamHandoff.notes: S04 may consume the versioned process-bound loopback/nonce handshake and public OpenAPI without importing supervisor or service-private modules. The endpoint and nonce remain native-host private until S04 adds authenticated transport and a generated renderer-safe client.

residualLimitations: Authenticated request transport, capability tokens, generated client compatibility, cancellation IDs, and request traces are intentionally owned by CAP-01.S04.
Installer signing, install/upgrade/repair/rollback, clean-VM packaging, and external artifacts are intentionally owned by CAP-01.S05.
